project_type: Flutter mobile app (home management) in Spanish, backend Supabase
build_system: Flutter SDK at ~/flutter_sdk (3.47.6, Dart 3.13.5). pubspec sdk ^3.11.1. No pub.dev publish.
test_framework: flutter_test. Tests live in test/*.dart. Repo tests cover PURE LOGIC (services/utils/model styling), not Supabase-backed widgets. See test/food_image_style_test.dart for the pattern of asserting on AppColors/style helpers.
build_command: export PATH="$HOME/flutter_sdk/bin:$PATH"; export FLUTTER_SUPPRESS_ANALYTICS=true; flutter pub get; flutter analyze
test_command: export PATH="$HOME/flutter_sdk/bin:$PATH"; export FLUTTER_SUPPRESS_ANALYTICS=true; flutter test
verification_instructions: Reproduce CI EXACTLY in this order: (1) flutter pub get; (2) dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed .  <-- NOTE the trailing '.' formats the WHOLE project incl. test/, a prior real failure was an unformatted test; (3) flutter analyze -> MUST print 'No issues found!'; (4) flutter test -> all green. Baseline on this branch = 167 tests passing. Do NOT drop below that.
snapshot_or_generated_files: flutter pub get rewrites autogenerated files that MUST be discarded with `git checkout -- <file>` before considering the tree clean: pubspec.lock, analysis_options.yaml (adds 'Upgrading analysis_options.yaml to exclude build and platform directories'), .flutter-plugins-dependencies, and plugin registrants under linux/ macos/ windows/. Only commit files you intentionally changed under lib/ test/.
setup_instructions: Flutter SDK already present at ~/flutter_sdk. If missing: git clone --depth 1 --branch 3.47.6 https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git ~/flutter_sdk . Then export PATH and FLUTTER_SUPPRESS_ANALYTICS=true and run flutter pub get.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET. Running flutter as root prints a warning but works. NO new external packages unless strongly justified (google_fonts/Nunito and fl_chart ^1.2.0 already present). Use ONLY Flutter's built-in animation framework: ImplicitlyAnimatedWidget / TweenAnimationBuilder / AnimatedBuilder / AnimationController. Honor MediaQuery reduce-motion.
contribution_requirements: This is a PURE UI/animation task: DO NOT touch supabase/ migrations (immutable, last is 0041), DB, or backend. Work from a NEW branch feat/sistema-diseno-animaciones off main (already created, independent of open PRs #97 feat/redundancias-calendario-mensual and #98 feat/rediseno-despensa). Do NOT push or open PRs; leave the tree committed and clean. CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml) gates format/analyze/test on every PR.
key_patterns: Theme centralized in lib/theme/app_theme.dart: class AppColors (Cozy palette: cream #FDF8E1, wood #E2C792, woodDark #B58A3C, ink #1E1E1E, card white, softShadow 0x14000000; pastel pairs sageBg/sage, terracottaBg/terracotta, peachBg/peach, frostBg/frost, favorite; expiry freshBg/fresh, soonBg/soon, expiredBg/expired). AppTheme.build uses Material3 + GoogleFonts.nunitoTextTheme. AppTheme.cardDecoration(radius) gives ONE flat shadow for everything. Mascot: lib/widgets/miau_character.dart (MiauCharacter, StatefulWidget, moods greeting/celebrating/sleeping/cooking/curious/neutral; already animates scale easeOutBack 450ms + 3s float). PITFALLS: setState with arrow returning Future breaks -> use {} body; FloatingActionButton needs unique heroTag (MainShell uses IndexedStack so all screens are alive at once); model fromMap tolerant to nulls; Icons.nutrition does NOT exist in 3.47.6; dart format uses 'tall style' (Dart 3.7+).
relevant_files: lib/theme/app_theme.dart (AppColors + AppTheme.build + cardDecoration; EXTEND here, do not break names)

lib/tabs/home_tab.dart (1588 lines; the Inicio screen to redesign. Header w/ MiauCharacter greeting, _quickAccessRow/_quickAccessButton (GestureDetector), card builders: _remindersCard, _mealsCard, _expiryCard, _caloriesCard, _tasksCard, _spendingCard, _calendarCard, _calorieGoalPrompt. Lots of hardcoded padding 14/16/18/20, radii 12/14/16/18/24, font sizes 10.5/11/13/14/15/22/24, Colors.grey[500/600/700]. Preserves DashboardPrefs personalization, navigation, task completion, profile prompts, refresh-on-return via refreshActiveView())
lib/widgets/miau_character.dart (mascot to keep/enhance, shows reduce-motion-worthy pattern)
lib/main_shell.dart (IndexedStack + NavigationBar 5 tabs; _onDestinationSelected calls refreshActiveView; optional LOW-RISK tab transition microanimation only if safe)
lib/models/dashboard_prefs.dart (DashboardCard enum reminders/meals/expiry/calories/tasks/spending/calendar; QuickAction enum; drives which cards render)
test/food_image_style_test.dart (PATTERN for pure-logic tests asserting on theme/style helpers)
test/widget_test.dart (existing widget tests that do not need Supabase)
directory_structure: lib/ (flat screens *.dart at root + models/ services/ utils/ widgets/ tabs/ theme/). tabs/ has home_tab/comidas_tab/despensa_tab. theme/ has only app_theme.dart. widgets/ has miau_character, food_category_icon, food_image, recipe_chip, recipe_image, coming_soon. test/ has 18 files, pure-logic style. supabase/ (DO NOT TOUCH). .github/workflows/ci.yml runs format/analyze/test.
